summary: Tested new mass billing generation by due date (lote por vencimento) endpoints + frontend dialog. 9/9 backend tests passed (1 skipped: non-admin enforcement requires unknown password). Frontend dialog renders all required data-testids, empty state shown, gerar button disabled when 0 selected.

minor.issue: counts_by_dia uses int keys when serialized to JSON they become strings - frontend handles this correctly but worth noting
Per-item N+1 DB lookups: for each subscription, queries clientes, linhas, ofertas individually. Will be slow at scale (>500 subs). Consider batching with $in queries.
Preview's anti-dup index keyed by (cliente_id, vencimento) only loads charges within target month range — correct, but POST endpoint does its own DB check (also correct). Logic OK.

issues: Accessibility warning: DialogContent missing aria-describedby / Description - non-blocking but worth adding <DialogDescription> for a11y

action_items: (Optional) Add <DialogDescription> inside lote-vencimento-dialog to fix Radix a11y warning
(Optional - performance) Batch cliente/linha/oferta lookups in preview endpoint using $in to avoid N+1 when subscription count grows
critical_code_review_comments: _calc_vencimento_from_dia correctly handles month-end edge case (e.g., dia=31 in Feb -> 28/29)
POST anti-dup check is per (cliente_id, vencimento) — matches user spec ('mesma data de vencimento exato'). Works.
Both endpoints handle ObjectId conversion errors gracefully with try/except.

POST endpoint requires admin via require_admin(); GET preview uses get_current_user() — any authenticated user can call preview. This may be acceptable but if strictly admin-only data, consider tightening.

When asaas_service.is_configured is False, POST appends error per item but does NOT insert a local-only cobranca — items list silently failing. Could be a UX surprise; consider returning a clear single error message instead of per-item errors when Asaas is down.
seed_data_creation: None. Dev env has 1 ACTIVE subscription with orphan cliente_id (expected per task note) — preview returns total=0 which is correct behavior. End-to-end anti-duplicate flow NOT tested against Asaas production (per testing context note to avoid real charges).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/carteira/cobrancas/lote/preview (GET, requires auth) and /api/carteira/cobrancas/lote/por-vencimento (POST, requires admin) are working. Anti-duplicate is keyed on (cliente_id, vencimento). To do end-to-end charge creation testing, seed a real cliente+assinatura in MongoDB to avoid real Asaas charges. Frontend dialog at /cobrancas → 'Por Vencimento' button is fully functional with empty state.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Feature functioning as specified.
